method: Repository snapshot audit based on six index files, including the 37 individually indexed planetary moon catalogue references.
coverageNote: These are index records, not unique physical objects and not the complete contents of external catalogues. The NASA index contains 29 planetary STL records cross-listed in Height Maps; count source files separately from collection placements. Catalogue-page references and archive packages are not individual mesh files. The 37 moon records are individually catalogued references to the source list, not direct model files.

indexes.note: 37 individual source-list references; no direct mesh endpoints assumed.

limitations: Cross-source physical-object matching is not complete; IDs are unique record IDs, not canonical object IDs.
The 256 asteroid records point to source detail pages and are not direct mesh files.
Archive package records represent ZIP/7Z bundles, not the number of meshes inside them.
The 3D Asteroid Catalogue reports 1,635 asteroids, 5 comets, 2 dwarf planets, 37 moons and 3,079 models; SPACEMESHER has not yet imported that full source inventory.
